supporting_observations.claim: A remote interactive logon by emma.stone from WS-ESTONE-01 to DC-PIN-01 was recorded at 13:24 UTC, before the alerted account creation time.
The available records do not establish whether emma.stone created tmp.rwong or whether that creation was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: Both winsec and Sysmon collection on DC-PIN-01 were unavailable from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC, covering the alerted creation time around 13:42 UTC.
The evidence provided contains no account-management event documenting tmp.rwong's creation, creator, group membership, or privileges.
claims_not_established: Who created tmp.rwong and whether the account was created during emma.stone's DC session.
Whether tmp.rwong was added only to Temp-Staff or granted other group membership or privileges.
Whether the account creation was authorized and followed the organization's temporary-account process.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-PIN-01 account-management and security audit logs for 13:30–14:15 UTC, including account creation and group-membership changes.
Check directory audit records or a domain-controller backup to establish tmp.rwong's creator, creation time, group memberships, and privileges.
Confirm with the help desk or change owner whether a temporary account for rwong was requested and approved.
unrelated_findings: At 13:52 UTC, emma.stone launched OpenSSH from WS-ESTONE-01 and connected to PROXY-PIN-01 on port 22; this is separate from the alerted account activity and may warrant a separate review. Records: T078-00060, T078-00062, T078-00065.
At 13:53 UTC, emma.stone's browser accessed the Cloudflare dashboard; this is outside the alerted account activity and may warrant separate context review. Records: T078-00067, T078-00068.
